summary: Iteration 67: Splash Screen and Reading Stats System - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend APIs (splash-pendente, confirmar, leitura stats, reenviar-splash) and Frontend UI (Admin Mensagens with Ver Leitura panel, Enviar Splash button) working correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash Screen and Reading Stats system fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/notificacoes/splash-pendente (returns pending splash for logged-in atleta), POST /api/notificacoes/splash/{id}/confirmar (marks splash as read), GET /api/admin/mensagens/{id}/leitura (returns reading stats with total, lidas, não lidas, percentual, and lists of atletas), POST /api/admin/mensagens/{id}/reenviar-splash (creates splash_admin notifications for unread users). Frontend: SplashScreenWrapper in App.js shows blocking modal for atletas with pending splash. Admin Mensagens has 'Ver Leitura' button that expands to show reading stats panel with 'Enviar Splash para estes' button.
